title: 355. Group Shifted Strings

examples.explanation: "abc", "bcd" and "xyz" share one shift pattern; "az" and "ba" share another; "a" and "z" are single letters; "acef" stands alone.
A single string forms its own group.

hints: Normalize each string by shifting it so its first character becomes 'a'.
Strings with equal normalized forms belong to the same group.
